name: Fold Hound
shortDescription: A wet shape the size of a sheepdog, with no honest bark.
lookDescription: A wet shape the size of a sheepdog stands in the lane and does not bark.
examineDescription: The Fold Hound is wool and mist packed into a dog's outline. It does not bark. It keeps the lane the way weather keeps a gate. Solo work. It is not Colm's dog. Colm did not keep a dog.
lockNarration: Mist packs tighter into the dog-shape.
victoryNarration: The Fold Hound thins into wet wool and a small bell. The lane is only a lane.
